title: S4-VIEW-03 — Quick tools follow the keymap.
goal: The Canvas tools quick menu opens from the focused canvas with Shift+F10, lists labelled tools and Swap colors, switches tool or swaps colors without touching artwork, closes with Escape, and never adds an artwork Undo step. The canvas is focused with the Eyedropper, which samples without editing. (With the Standard keymap a right-click on the artwork paints with the secondary color by design; only the space around the artwork opens the menu by mouse.)
cliOnly: right-click outside the artwork and the Classic keymap's right-click menu, by coordinates

steps.why: I selects the Eyedropper, which never edits pixels.
The Eyedropper sampled Bun's centre pixel.
Shift+F10 on the focused canvas opens the Canvas tools menu.
Choosing a tool closes the menu.
Choosing a tool changed no artwork.
Swap moves the sampled color to the secondary well.
Opening, using and closing the menu changed no artwork.
